facts.text: Eat first. The shell opens every eighteen hours, and we go in with a full stomach.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Louise never says this. Her lines on the quote page I opened (a long list) do not include it or anything about eating. A real short line she says is 'If you could see your whole life from start to finish, would you change things?'
facts.fix: If you could see your whole life from start to finish, would you change things?

facts.text: Ian's story. Kangaroo means I don't know.
facts.why: Louise tells the Captain Cook kangaroo story, not Ian, and the punchline is that 'kangaroo' means 'I don't understand'.
facts.fix: Louise's story. Kangaroo: I don't understand.
